data.raw_text:
Nag-switch ang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) sa tinatawag na "adaptive signaling system."

Ibig sabihin nito, ayon kay MMDA Chairman Atty. Don Artes, 
sensor-based na ang mga traffic lights na siyang tutukoy kung stop o go ang mga sasakyan.

Ipinabatid ni Artes na isandaang porsyento nang natapos ang pagtatanggal ng mga traffic signal light timers na nasa ilalim ng pamamahala ng ahensiya.

Ang MMDA Traffic Engineering Center ang nangasiwa sa pagtatanggal ng mga traffic signal light timers sa 96 signalized intersections sa Metro Manila. 

#mmda 
#mmdaatyourservice

Don Artes, sensor-based traffic lights that would be known to determine whether to stop or go vehicles. Artes announced that a hundred percetotoss when the removal of traffic signals from the agency’s light time system ended. The MMDA Traffic Engineering Center directed the release of light traffic signals in the Metrosuction.

Efforts are underway for its evacuation. Though, this development has little or no impact on traffic in the area, however, our men are present there to facilitate the evacuation process as well as monitor traffic behavior around the impedement.

#FollowLASTMA
